question: What state is claimed for one freed from all diseases in relation to union with yogis?
premises: One is freed from all diseases.
That one is in relation to yogis.
A state of union together with yogis is indicated.
inference: One freed from all diseases attains union together with yogis.
uncertainties: The exact nature of saha+melakam is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Freed from all diseases, one attains union together with yogis.
